compliance_metrics.name: Secure development lifecycle
compliance_metrics.description: Rules for secure development of software and systems should be established and applied.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Ensure secure development practices are defined and applied to all AI-related software and systems.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Embed secure-SDLC gates into AI system builds

compliance_metrics.name: Secure coding
compliance_metrics.description: Ensure that APIs are secured with strong authentication, encryption, and proper access controls.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Guarantee that APIs for AI model access are implemented with secure coding standards to prevent unauthorized access or data leaks.
compliance_metrics.reporting_format: Security audit logs and conformance reports

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: API authentication, encryption, and access control best practices applied

compliance_metrics.name: Access control
compliance_metrics.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to the AI system should be established and implemented.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Ensure physical and logical access to AI systems is restricted and monitored to prevent unauthorized use or data leakage.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Access controls in place for AI system environments, including admin and user segregation

compliance_metrics.name: Access rights
compliance_metrics.description: Access rights to the AI system should be provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed in accordance with access control policies.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Ensure AI system access rights are managed consistently throughout the user lifecycle to prevent unauthorized access.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Lifecycle management of AI access rights aligned with access control policies

compliance_metrics.name: Secure authentication
compliance_metrics.description: Ensure that only authorized users can access the software and the API through strong authentication mechanisms.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Verify that authentication mechanisms prevent unauthorized access to AI systems and APIs.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Authentication mechanisms protect AI system and API access against unauthorized use

compliance_metrics.name: Web filtering
compliance_metrics.description: Implement rate limiting and throttling to restrict the number of requests a user or system can make to the model, preventing data harvesting.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Ensure that request limits are enforced to mitigate the risk of model extraction or abuse via automated access.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Rate limiting and throttling mechanisms applied to protect AI model endpoints from automated data harvesting

compliance_metrics.name: Model encryption
compliance_metrics.description: Encrypt model weights and parameters to prevent unauthorized access.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Ensure encryption mechanisms are applied to protect AI model assets from theft or unauthorized access.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Encryption of model assets to protect confidentiality and integrity

compliance_metrics.name: Data validation and sanitization
compliance_metrics.description: Implement data validation routines to identify and filter out anomalous or suspicious data.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Ensure input data is validated and sanitized to protect the model from data poisoning and maintain data integrity.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Mechanisms to detect and prevent data poisoning and ensure data quality

compliance_metrics.name: Data anomaly identification
compliance_metrics.description: Use defense techniques to identify unusual or adversarial data patterns.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Detect anomalous and adversarial inputs to protect model integrity against data poisoning.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Protection against data poisoning by identifying anomalous data

compliance_metrics.name: Model validation
compliance_metrics.description: Continuously monitor and validate model performance to detect unexpected deviations caused by poisoned data.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Ensure ongoing monitoring and validation to identify performance issues linked to data poisoning.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Protection against data poisoning by monitoring model performance

compliance_metrics.name: Model ensemble
compliance_metrics.description: Use multiple machine learning models trained on different subsets of data to improve robustness and accuracy of threat detection.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Enhance model robustness by leveraging diverse models to mitigate data poisoning and improve detection accuracy.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Protection against data poisoning through diverse model ensembles

compliance_metrics.name: Data augmentation
compliance_metrics.description: Apply data augmentation techniques to diversify training data and increase resilience to small-scale poisoning attacks.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Increase dataset diversity to reduce impact of adversarial poisoning and improve model generalization.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Mitigation of poisoning attacks via data diversification

compliance_metrics.name: Data quality monitoring
compliance_metrics.description: Continuously monitor data quality, set thresholds for acceptable metrics, and automatically flag or quarantine data below standards.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Ensure high data quality to prevent model degradation and data poisoning.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Protection against data poisoning by monitoring data quality

compliance_metrics.name: Active learning
compliance_metrics.description: Employ active learning strategies to prioritize labeling of the most informative data points.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Optimize data labeling to improve model accuracy and resilience to poisoned data.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Reduction of data poisoning impact through active learning

compliance_metrics.name: Access control
compliance_metrics.description: Establish and implement rules controlling physical and logical access to training data, models, or model servers.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Prevent unauthorized access to training and production assets to protect data and model integrity.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Protection against unauthorized access to AI assets

compliance_metrics.name: Access rights
compliance_metrics.description: Provision, review, modify, and remove access rights to training/production data, models, and relevant assets following access control policies.
compliance_metrics.information_need: Ensure access rights management follows policies to prevent misuse or unauthorized data/model manipulation.

associated_control.associated_control_requirement: Control over access rights to protect data and model confidentiality

compliance_metrics.name: Information security in supplier relationship
compliance_metrics.description: Processes and procedures should be defined and implemented to manage information security risks associated with the use of the AI platform.

compliance_metrics.name: Information security for use of cloud services
compliance_metrics.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management, and exit from cloud services including the AI platform should be established.

compliance_metrics.name: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
compliance_metrics.description: Processes and procedures should be defined and implemented to manage information security risks in the ICT supply chain to avoid vulnerabilities that could allow malicious access to poison the AI model.

compliance_metrics.name: Screening
compliance_metrics.description: Background verification checks on all candidates should be carried out prior to joining and on an ongoing basis to avoid potential insider threats.

compliance_metrics.name: Information security awareness
compliance_metrics.description: Educate data scientists and personnel about data poisoning risks and best practices for securing AI data.

compliance_metrics.name: Physical controls
compliance_metrics.description: Include controls for physical security perimeters, protecting against physical and environmental threats, securing premises, storage media, and preventing unauthorized physical access to training data or servers.

compliance_metrics.name: Secure authentication
compliance_metrics.description: Ensure that only authorized users can modify training data.

compliance_metrics.name: Secure development lifecycle
compliance_metrics.description: Rules for secure development of software and systems should be established and applied throughout the AI system lifecycle.

compliance_metrics.name: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
compliance_metrics.description: Principles for engineering secure systems should be established, documented, maintained, and applied to all information system development activities to minimize potential security threats.

compliance_metrics.name: Adversarial Training
compliance_metrics.description: Train models with adversarial examples to strengthen their robustness against adversarial attacks.

compliance_metrics.name: Data Augmentation and Randomization
compliance_metrics.description: Apply data augmentation techniques and randomization to input data to make it harder for attackers to craft effective adversarial examples.

compliance_metrics.name: Input Validation
compliance_metrics.description: Implement mechanisms to filter invalid data or sanitize to remove or neutralize characters or patterns that could be exploited.

compliance_metrics.name: Input Distortion
compliance_metrics.description: Slight modification of the input data to distort adversarial attacks causing them to fail.

compliance_metrics.name: Adversarial Detection
compliance_metrics.description: Deploy adversarial detection mechanisms that can identify and flag potential adversarial examples for further inspection.

compliance_metrics.name: Transfer Knowledge
compliance_metrics.description: Transfer knowledge from robust teacher models to student models to make the student model resilient to adversarial attacks.
